reviews.t: Love, perfect for at home manicures
reviews.x: I decided to start saving money by doing my own manicures at home and these have helped tremendously. Using the brushes and a little acetone I can get a beautifully clean edge around my cuticle and it looks so pro. I plan on trying some nail art using them and the opposite ends with the dotting tools. There are so many great tutorials out there and all kinds of things you can do with them. This is a great set and very well priced, you definitely can't go wrong with these nail tools
The color on the brushes comes off when you use alcohol or nail polish remover

reviews.t: so it is definitely great! I love the case and that the dotting ...
reviews.x: I bought this for myself and before you know it, my daughter, who is a cosmetologist, stole it! She does nails and recently took it to a class. Some of the fellow cosmetologists/nail techs asked where she got it, so it is definitely great! I love the case and that the dotting tools are on the brushes.. It's so convenient!

reviews.t: Nice brushes and No shedding thus far
reviews.x: Nice brushes and No shedding thus far! I do my own hard gel nails at home and needed extra brushes for nail art. These definitely get the job done. (See pic) Shipping was easy and fast as well.

reviews.t: Why would you sell nail art brushes that melt from acetone?
reviews.x: Acetone wrecks the brush handles. Its just stupid.

reviews.t: Fell apart coming out of the case.
reviews.x: I returned these, as soon as I took them out of the case the tips started falling off the brushes. I could have glued them back on but I don't feel like I should have to repair a brand new product

Giving this item 3 stars is being, I would say, very gracious. When I saw that this product was from bundle monster I expected so much more from this. With that being said. I really like the variety with the tools. And the bag is awesome, it magnetically snaps together for easy close, but secure. The brushes them selves are great. My only complaint I have is regarding the handle of the brushes. As I was cleaning up I felt something sticky/tacky from were I held the brush. I noticed that the colo

Fast shipping (I have prime) & just as described by seller. The case & brushes/dotting tools are nice quality for the price. I haven't had any strands from the brushes fall out & after cleaning & placing the plastic "straw" like caps back over the bristles, they have all held their shape just fine. My only complaint is if you get polish remover on the colored part that turquoise paint does come off & then gets all over your fingers! Ther than that these are a great deal!

Very cute and very nice brushes. I'm excited to use them for my gel nails! I love doing nail designs and this is the perfect package.  Update: I have been using these brushes for a bit now. I LOVE all the different sizes of dotting tools. This allows me to make any design I want. I am so happy.

reviews.t: Brush handle paint comes off w/ acetone
reviews.x: The brushes are fine but I would not recommend these. I use them for regular polish and remove the polish with acetone. If you get any remover on the brush handles the paint comes off and becomes very sticky and messy.

I purchase this for my wife and my 15 year old daughter... they LOVE IT :) The material is really good to the touch and they say that the brushes are pretty accurate...  The only downside is that the ball ends of the brushes are repeated... I mean, there are one big, one medium and one small... I thought that maybe some other ends could be included.  Overall was a good purchase.

reviews.t: I bought this product for the 2-way function and the ...
reviews.x: I bought this product for the 2-way function and the color, I'm quite a beginner in nail art so I think as far as quality it does its job well enough to do basic designs. Having the bag organizer helps with storage too and keeping them all together.
The teal colored part of the handles has already cracked and come off and I barely use these.

reviews.t: It's very cute, but quality of brushes - could have been better!!
reviews.x: Quality of brushes a bit low, again, the kit is not that whole lot expensive, so it's ok.

I ordered these for my daughter who loves to do her nails and do artwork on them.  She LOVED these!  They have very defined brissles and it allows her to do very small designs.  I highly recommend these!!

reviews.t: Wonderful tools! I ordered them to paint on rocks ...
reviews.x: Wonderful tools!  I ordered them to paint on rocks and sandollars, and they are just perfect for dotting. The brushes are nice and tiny as well.  Super set.
Small and cute. I actually have more control with these brushes so I can do more. The case they came in was a nice, unexpected bonus.

reviews.t: and the brushes are amazing, love the color
reviews.x: I wish I could give this item more stars.  Fast service, and the brushes are amazing, love the color.  Keep up the good work.
Love creating Nail Art without searching for multiple tools - increase salon session!
The thin striping brush deteriorated quickly, everything else is great!
Good price point, but the quality is not that great.
Turquoise paint peeled off after first use

First time nail artist here so don't judge the pic too harsh please! Decided to take up nail art and was pleased to find such a good deal on starter tools. The carrying case is good and has plastic over the tips. I think once I've had more practice I won't need anymore tools unless there are specialty ones I do t know about! There was a bit of residue on the dotting ends, but it wiped right off and was probably left there by the manufacturer not the seller.

This is a great set! Every piece gives a different effect to your art, and can be used with nail stamping. As shown in the video review, this set comes with a great case, and is well protected.  You can also see that one of the brushes (3rd in from the right) is slightly lopsided, and that is the ONLY reason I did not give 5 stars. Overall, this is great set.

Great item for the price and love the double ended brushes. Making uniform dot designs on your nails is so easy and there's a nice variety of sizes for dots. The brushes can be used to do pretty much anything you can dream up - side of nail clean-up, stripes, etc. Oh, and it has a great storage case to store and protect your set, too.

claims.text: Many reviewers love these brushes for at-home manicures and nail art, praising the variety of sizes and dotting tools.
Several reviewers report the brush handles' paint or color comes off or becomes sticky when exposed to acetone or nail polish remover.
Some reviewers praise the quality, noting no shedding and that the brushes hold their shape well.
A few reviewers report durability problems, including tips falling off and handles cracking.
Reviewers appreciate the included case/bag for storage and organization.
